title: What if Goku joined the Avengers? The budget is cooked.
assumptions: Fan-made Dragon Ball/Marvel crossover; this is an invented alternate scenario, not canon or an official trailer.
Quoted character reactions and power outcomes are invented comedic narration, not authentic movie dialogue.
Existing clips can show the named characters but cannot literally depict Goku fighting Thanos; such beats are illustrative juxtaposition.

scenes.label: EARTH IS FINANCIALLY COOKED
scenes.text: What if Goku joined the Avengers? Earth's insurance company is cooked.

scenes.label: THE DRESS CODE
scenes.text: Tony sees the hair and asks, is that in the dress code?

scenes.label: THE GREEN RAGE FRIDGE
scenes.text: Brother, your team hired a green rage fridge. Relax.

scenes.label: FREE TRAINING PARTNER
scenes.text: In this crossover, Thor calls himself a god. Goku hears free training partner.

scenes.label: THE WELCOME PARTY
scenes.text: Congratulations. The welcome party now needs a demolition permit.

scenes.label: CAPTAIN HAS A PLAN
scenes.text: Captain America says they need a plan.

scenes.label: SCREAMING IS NOT A STRATEGY
scenes.text: My guy, this man thinks strategy means screaming until his hair updates.

scenes.label: LUNCH REQUIRES FUNDING
scenes.text: Then they order lunch. Motherflicker, they need a second budget.

scenes.label: CALL THE ACCOUNTANT
scenes.text: Goku calls it a snack. Tony calls his accountant.

scenes.label: HERE COMES THE SPEECH
scenes.text: Thanos starts the usual galaxy speech.

scenes.label: PURPLE AND UNEMPLOYED
scenes.text: Goku asks, are you strong, or just purple and unemployed?

scenes.label: AURA MEETS AIRPORT SECURITY
scenes.text: All that villain aura. Suddenly he is getting checked like carry on luggage.

scenes.label: HE LETS THE VILLAIN POWER UP
scenes.text: But Goku gives the bad guy a chance to power up.

scenes.label: PREMIUM EMERGENCY
scenes.text: Oh, fantastic. Our emergency has a premium subscription.

scenes.label: PLEASE FINISH THE FIGHT
scenes.text: The Avengers are begging him to finish the fight.

scenes.label: WALKING SIDE QUEST
scenes.text: He wants a rematch. This walking side quest needs adult supervision.

scenes.label: EARTH STILL NEEDS A HERO
scenes.text: Still, they would want him protecting Earth.

scenes.label: CONFISCATE THE GROCERY CARD
scenes.text: Just keep him away from mission planning and the grocery card.

scenes.label: SAVE THE TEAM OR BANKRUPT IT
scenes.text: Would he save the team, or bankrupt it before the next invasion?
